review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; design self-review, not independent approval
review.decision: Keep automatic wakes out of the future Codex queue and reserve a safe window for queued rotation
review.notes: Bounded production observation matched 29 old automatic wake payload hashes to accepted spool receipts; recent inputs entered the conversation roughly three hours after acceptance, with consecutive task_complete/task_started separated by milliseconds. Do not equate visible empty composer with completed idle, or clear/replay existing native queues. Introduce a separate idle-only wake RPC policy that uses verified thread metadata and one normal turn/start with no steer/queue fallback; preserve explicit human and attachment paths. Existing hqinput lease plus bounded read-only pending reservation holds NEW wake batches before claim, after existing own stranded-repair handling. Only unsent rotation reserves; sent handoff can use existing bootstrap. Process normal rotation before wake draining on fast/slow ticks; retain all original identity, owner, draft, two-frame and turn-boundary checks. Failure is important/audible through existing notification channel once, not queued back into the broken HQ conversation. Existing native queue contents are untouched and may still prevent immediate recovery of the currently deployed old session. Current source candidates, shared dirty root and all protected materials remain unchanged. No live TUI/socket/queue/marker/config/service input during implementation. HQ c02b follow-up additionally requires admission race and important alert visibility. Creation of a rotation request must share the input lease with automatic batch claims; contention never falsely reports queued. Preserve old input/owner/draft guards. Native idle-start acceptance is an accepted transport/start receipt, not model-read or business consumption: journal it separately from a confirmed legacy delivery and never advance event consumption. Source important events/owner notification policy remain independently visible and unchanged; local priority/key coalescing may not silently consume or downgrade them. Existing 10-minute wake watchdog is not claimed immediate blocked-task notification. The current backend idle-to-busy start contract must be checked against the loaded native protocol or conservatively refuse; unknown cannot become future queue input. HQ529d technical correction: installed0.169 schema and official TurnStartParams prove no atomic idle-only public precondition. Retain native wakes with fresh exact loaded-idle metadata and one ordinary turn/start; busy/unknown retain locally. Never future-queue/steer/fallback. Sampling-to-submit race remains: a successful response may have appended to an externally started active turn. Record accepted/observed turn, never causally started/model-read/events-consumed. No capability fiction or blanket native disable. Existing audit records remain routine; rotation failure also queues an independent owner desktop notification, with important display semantics, without routing its alert back into the same HQ. Existing desktop/quiet/follow permissions are not widened. Notification queued is not proven OS presentation.

cases.description: Automatic native wakes only start an explicitly loaded idle thread
cases.setup: Use the production RPC path with synthetic exact-home/thread/peer responses for idle, active, approvals, unloaded, unsupported metadata/start, lost receipts and changed target. Include idle sample then externally active before request write; successful response returning existing turn and an uncertain/lost receipt.
cases.action: Submit an idle-only wake and inspect the actual wire and claim counts.
cases.expected: Fresh verified idle metadata is required before at most one normal turn/start attempt. Known busy/unknown/unloaded/approval states refuse before claim; no steer, queue/add, resume, retry or fallback. Sample-to-submit external race is explicitly possible: a valid response records acceptance and an observed turn ID only, not proof of a newly caused turn. Missing acknowledgement remains uncertain, never automatically resubmitted. Explicit user/image/legacy queue unchanged.

cases.description: The actual native dispatch selects idle-only policy for automatic wakes
cases.setup: Actual codexNativeSubmit with isolated spool, exact attachment and recording policy seams.
cases.action: Send automatic wake, busy refusal and ordinary/direct-user controls through the production adapter.
cases.expected: Automatic wake uses only idle policy and retains exact target/send identity; busy refusal before claim retains authority and produces no accepted receipt. Ordinary user/CLI/screenshot selection remains unchanged.

cases.description: Queued rotation reserves input without granting authority
cases.action: Read the reservation using bounded private no-follow IO; compare all original bytes.
cases.expected: Only matching unsent pending maintenance reserves new automatic input; sent handoff and other panes do not. Read failures conservatively hold automatic delivery and never authorize/reset/repair config. Missing returns no hold, no writes or blocking special-file read.

cases.description: Public wake channels retain batches behind pending rotation
cases.setup: Production Deliver/DeliverKeyedAt/Drain, fake native/terminal I/O and synthetic pending rotation. Include an existing exact stranded own batch and uncertain claims.
cases.action: Deliver and drain repeatedly before/after sent or removed reservation; inspect queue, captures, mutation calls and maintenance file.
cases.expected: No new batch is claimed/submitted/pasted while unsent maintenance reserves input. Keyed coalescing and original IDs/content survive. Existing own stranded repair still works; uncertain input is never requeued; drafts/foreign pane safeguards remain. Normal drain resumes after reservation ends.

cases.description: Native wake entry passes the idle-only contract and preserves HQ identity hold
cases.setup: Actual nativeWakeSubmit with isolated recording DispatchIO and exact/changed HQ resolver.
cases.action: Observe the production dispatch options and refusal/success.
cases.expected: Idle-only flag is set only for automatic wake, stable delivery identity remains, changed HQ rejects before mutation. No legacy queue or direct-user behavior is silently selected.

cases.description: Rotation timeout is visible and cannot repeat from an old snapshot
cases.setup: Actual queued request and advanceHQRotation with synthetic clock, transcript boundary and fake pane; normal native notification queue in isolated HOME.
cases.action: Expire without a safe completed boundary, then invoke the old snapshot again.
cases.expected: Exactly one original routine failure audit with reason and one independent owner desktop-notification request where supported; queued is not proven presentation. Session/history/draft/queue remain, no reset input, stale replay does nothing. Production fast-tick priority wiring is reviewed statically, not claimed actual scheduler/TUI execution.

cases.description: Rotation registration and automatic batch claims serialize on the same input lease
cases.setup: Actual queueHQRotation in isolated HOME while a cooperating input lease is held, then released; existing same-target pending request and a different request controls.
cases.action: Try registration during contention, create after release, retry and attempt conflicting registration; retain exact request bytes.
cases.expected: No new pending request or input while another writer owns admission. After release one durable request is accepted; retries do not change ID/deadline, conflicts do not overwrite it. Claim cannot pass an unsent request registered before its lease. Identity validation before actual reset remains unchanged.

cases.description: Busy wake retention preserves important source events and does not claim consumption
cases.setup: Public automatic wake path with busy/unknown native input, separate important blocking event and lower-priority keyed routine notices; normal owner event read and existing notification/follow policy.
cases.action: Hold/coalesce notices while busy or rotating, then admit one idle start and inspect journal, priority, exact receipts and source events.
cases.expected: No persistent native future queue input, no delivered/consumed audit on busy or unknown, no watermark advance or removal of source important events. Typed fresh-idle input acceptance (not causal turn-start proof) is distinct from exact confirmed delivery; retained priorities/key updates survive. Existing source notifications/quiet/follow policy are not bypassed; runtime desktop delivery is an installation acceptance limit.
